title: Hearty Smoky Moroccan Pistachio Chebakia
description: A yeasty, tender, and energizing Moroccan dish featuring ground pistachios, smoky flavors, and a traditional chebakia form, served in a dolsot stone bowl.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, ground pistachios, yeast, smoked paprika, and salt.
Gradually add the olive oil, rose water, and orange blossom water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and shape it into chebakia forms.
Place the chebakia in a dolsot stone bowl and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the chebakia from the oven and brush it with honey.
Serve the chebakia warm in the dolsot stone bowl.
